text:
alex: Heads-up — CI runner dropped the batch_size label on a bunch of eval runs, summary cards show empty buckets.
maya: saw that too, repro on staging. a few runs have batch_size:null in the metadata.
ben: looking at runner logs now, might be from the new batching refactor.
ben: paste of the relevant log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z INFO runner:start run_id=eval-20260318-92 batch_size=8
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z WARN runner:metadata-serialize failed fields=[batch_size] err="nil value"
2026-03-18T14:12:04Z INFO runner:complete run_id=eval-20260318-92 tokens=1234
```
alex: that WARN is the culprit — UI expects a numeric batch_size in telemetry, but CI exported null.
irene: product question — does this affect summary exports? we had a customer asking about missing buckets in CSV.
maya: yes, export CSV groups by batch_size so those rows land in an "(unnamed)" column.
ben: small patch queued. adding defensive serialization to coerce nil -> 1 and adding tests.
ben: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/eval-runner/pull/482
ci-bot: build started for PR 482
alex: can we backfill affected runs for last 24h before merge so dashboard numbers don't jump?
maya: I can run a one-off job to re-ingest metadata if PR looks safe.
irene: please ping me once the backfill is done, we'll update the customer and the export docs.
ben: CI job passed unit tests, integration is flaky (two flakes on metrics-serializer). rerunning.
ci-bot: build passed
ben: merged. follow-up: backfill started (job id backfill-20260318-7). I'll post logs.
maya: confirmed staging summary cards show batch_size buckets again.
alex: thanks team :tada: — let's add a small alert on the dashboard when a metadata field is missing so it's easier to spot next time.
irene: created a ticket in product board: PROD-732 (add dataset-completeness banner on insights panels).
maya: filing a short post-mortem note in the eval harness channel after backfill completes.
alex: perfect. closing the thread once backfill + docs update done.
